primary.title: The Well-Tempered Clavier
primary.author: Johann Sebastian Bach
primary.rationale: A seminal collection of preludes and fugues, representing Bach's mastery of counterpoint and keyboard composition. While the original manuscripts are primary, printed editions and transcriptions are widely available.

primary.title: Brandenburg Concertos
primary.author: Johann Sebastian Bach
primary.rationale: A collection of six instrumental concertos, showcasing Bach's innovative orchestral writing and compositional techniques. Scores and analyses are readily accessible.

primary.title: Mass in B minor
primary.author: Johann Sebastian Bach
primary.rationale: One of Bach's last and most significant choral works, representing the culmination of his sacred music. Full scores and vocal scores are widely published and digitized.

secondary.title: Bach
secondary.author: Christoph Wolff
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and highly regarded biography by a leading Bach scholar, offering deep insights into his life, work, and historical context.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Bach
secondary.author: John Butt
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by various scholars covering different aspects of Bach's music, performance, and reception.

secondary.title: J.S. Bach: The Complete Works
secondary.author: Klaus Hofmann
secondary.rationale: An extensive overview of Bach's entire oeuvre, providing context and analysis for his compositions.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources for Bach are primarily his musical compositions. While letters and documents exist, they are less voluminous than his musical output. Availability on digital platforms often refers to printed editions of scores and scholarly analyses rather than original manuscripts.
